1.0.3: jsonToXml: fix the input json as a string.
1.0.4: Fix: JsonToXml now handles format:true with missing or numeric indentBy, preventing crash when indentBy is undefined.
1.0.5: Output examples for the XML components.
1.0.6: Security: replaced the abandoned xmldom 0.6.0 with its maintained successor @xmldom/xmldom 0.8.15 (XML injection, multiple-root and quadratic DoS advisories).
Security: upgraded fast-xml-parser 4.2.5 to 4.5.7 (entity expansion and parsing DoS advisories).

Behaviour changes: in XPath, malformed XML with more than one root element keeps only the first root, truncated XML can lose inner elements, and '>' in text is serialised as '>'. In XmlToJson, entities are decoded when processEntities is unset, and JsonToXml escapes comment and CDATA delimiters.
1.0.7: Security: upgraded fast-xml-parser 4.5.7 to 5.7.3 (XMLBuilder comment and CDATA injection, GHSA-gh4j-gqv2-49f6).
